newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool market quiet as price outlook cloudy.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool market quiet as price outlook cloudy.

text.p: Buyers proved shy of a Bradford tops market overshadowed by a moody outlook for prices, trade sources said on Monday.
"There are too many uncertainties for buyers to move in confidently although there's been a steady trickle of price-conscious business," one said.
While currency movements exerted a firming influence on prices, it was offset by a week of see-sawing raw wool values and the endemically easy availability of most descriptions, traders reported.
"With merinos rising while crossbreds eased, and crossbreds recovering while merinos lost ground, noone is quite sure what to expect," a market source said.
Ongoing resistance to higher prices from important retail buyers served to keep a cap on the market and most quotations were left unchanged, traders said. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
